hero.headline: Easy money management for budget, income, and expense tracking
hero.subheadline: Control your daily expenses, plan your budget, and start saving. If you find yourself wondering "Where did my money go?" at the end of the month, Spendoa is for you.

highlights.title: 💡 HIGHLIGHTED FEATURES
highlights.subtitle: AI-powered tools designed to simplify your expense tracking and budget planning.

scanning.title: 📸 Smart Receipt Scanning
scanning.description: No need to type everything manually. Just take a photo, and expenses are automatically detected and categorized.

analysis.title: 📊 Detailed Expense Tracking & Analysis
analysis.description: Analyze food, transport, rent, and all other expenses with charts. Spot unnecessary spending and save money.

shared.title: 🤝 Joint Budget Management
shared.description: Create a shared budget with family members, your spouse, or friends. Track income and expenses together.

alerts.title: 🔔 Budget Limits & Alerts
alerts.description: Set category-based budgets. Get notified as you approach your spending limit and stay in control.

score.title: 🏆 Financial Score & Savings Tracking
score.description: Analyze your spending habits and improve your financial situation. Reach your goals by saving more.

security.title: 🛡️ Secure Data Storage
security.description: All your financial data is stored securely. Your data belongs only to you and is protected at the highest level.
